definitions.gloss: side job done at home; piecework; cottage industry work
definitions.explanation: Work done at home for extra income, typically simple manual tasks like assembly, packaging, or addressing envelopes. Traditionally associated with housewives earning supplementary income.

definitions.gloss: doing something else secretly; doing unrelated work during class or a meeting
definitions.explanation: Doing something unrelated during a meeting, class, or other activity where one should be paying attention. A colloquial extension of the original meaning.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{内|ない}→〜内：09853_nai⟧ (inside, home) + ⟦{職|しょく}→職：00376_shoku⟧ (work, job). Originally refers to piecework done at home — a traditional way for homemakers to earn extra income. The word has developed a common colloquial sense of secretly doing unrelated work during class or meetings.

USAGE:
Sense 2 is very common among students, who use {内職|ないしょく} to mean studying for another subject or doing homework during a boring class. In office settings, it refers to working on personal tasks or other projects during meetings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {内職|ないしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to do side work / to work on the side
- ⟦{在宅|ざいたく}→在宅：07696_zaitaku⟧{内職|ないしょく} — work-from-home side job
- {内職|ないしょく}⟦{商法|しょうほう}→商法：30086_shouhou⟧ — home-work scam (fraudulent schemes)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{副業|ふくぎょう}→副業：08479_fukugyou⟧ — side job, second job; broader and more modern term for any secondary work
- ⟦アルバイト→アルバイト：01528_arubaito⟧ — part-time job; typically outside the home
